This is a CODE change, not a re-reading of the old code. DemonFormPower.cs:21 declares AfterSideTurnStart and the power is now on the new `after_side_turn_start` dispatcher (CombatManager.cs:522), which the sim fires AFTER the hand draw and after `on_player_turn_started`. The executed Hellraiser witness inverts back to the game's answer: the Strikes are drawn and auto-played before the Strength lands, so they go out un-Strengthened. See power/crimson_mantle's entry for the split itself. The enemy leg keeps its own guard entry.  The gap it replaced read: LIVE. The player leg is one slot too early. The sim's on_player_turn_start (player.py:169) fires BEFORE the hand draw (player.py:171-186), where C#'s AfterSideTurnStart is dispatched at CombatManager.cs:522, AFTER SetupPlayerTurn (:514) has reset energy and drawn the hand. The sim's matching post-draw slot is on_player_turn_started (player.py:186). EXECUTED: a spy listener records [on_player_turn_start hand=5, 4x on_card_drawn, on_player_turn_started hand=9]. Third-file citations, not hashed here. EXECUTED co-occurrence witness with two ported Ironclad cards: Hellraiser (cards/hellraiser.py:36) auto-plays every Strike as it is DRAWN, and Demon Form (cards/demon_form_card.py:35) grants Strength at turn start. On the turn after Demon Form 2 is played, the sim grants the Strength first and the auto-played Strikes take it with them -- enemy HP 41 -> 17 -- where the game draws (and auto-plays) first and only then grants Strength, leaving those Strikes un-Strengthened at 41 -> 23. Six damage the game never deals. The enemy leg (powers.py:221-224) has the separate per-creature problem recorded in its own guard entry.
